SELECT a.art_lin AS categoria,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.alm_cdd='Monterrey' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unidades_monterrey,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.alm_cdd='Guadalajara' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unidades_guadalajara
FROM exidet e
JOIN almmst m ON m.alm_id = e.exi_alm
JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = e.exi_art
GROUP BY a.art_lin
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN m.alm_cdd='Monterrey' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN m.alm_cdd='Guadalajara' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY a.art_lin

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS corte FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) AS stock_total
          FROM artmst a WHERE a.art_crt = true),
venta AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30 FROM vtadia v, c
          WHERE v.vta_fch <= c.corte AND v.vta_fch > c.corte - 30 GROUP BY v.vta_art)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM stock s JOIN venta v ON v.vta_art = s.art_cd
WHERE v.u30 > 0 AND s.stock_total / (v.u30 / 30.0) < 7

argumentos.sql:
WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte,
         COALESCE(s.stock,0) AS stock, COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0 AS vd
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true
)
SELECT prv_nm AS proveedor, prv_dte AS dias, COUNT(*) AS skus_en_riesgo
FROM base
WHERE vd > 0 AND (stock / vd) < prv_dte
GROUP BY prv_nm, prv_dte
ORDER BY skus_en_riesgo DESC, prv_nm ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH st AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_ptr, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art=a.art_cd),0) AS stock FROM artmst a) SELECT COUNT(*) AS criticos FROM st s WHERE s.stock < s.art_ptr AND s.art_crt = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art=s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
st AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) AS stock
       FROM artmst a),
d90 AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)/90.0 AS d FROM vtadia v, c
        WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 89 AND c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_cst,
           CEIL(COALESCE(d.d,0) * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
         FROM st s LEFT JOIN d90 d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
         WHERE s.stock < s.art_ptr
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))),
niv AS (SELECT qty*art_cst AS monto FROM prop)
SELECT
 SUM(CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comprador,
 SUM(CASE WHEN monto >= 50000 AND monto <= 250000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gerente,
 SUM(CASE WHEN monto > 250000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS director,
 COUNT(*) AS total
FROM niv

  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, CEIL(0.2*COUNT(*))::int AS k FROM artmst),

ventas AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art)

JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND v.u > 0

ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH v AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS qty,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS val
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
r AS (

SELECT ROUND(SUM(val)::numeric, 2) AS valor,

d AS (SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und)/90.0 AS dpd FROM vtadia, c WHERE vta_fch > c.corte - 90 AND vta_fch <= c.corte GROUP BY vta_art),
s AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(q.cant * a.art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM artmst a
JOIN s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CEIL(COALESCE(d.dpd,0) * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END)::int AS cant) q
WHERE s.stock < a.art_ptr
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))"

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock_total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art),
vent AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)/90.0 AS prom90 FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch <= c.f AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst,
         CEIL(COALESCE(vt.prom90,0) * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN vent vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst BETWEEN 50000 AND 250000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CEIL(COALESCE(d.dpd,0) * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) * a.art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto, COUNT(*) AS n FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN (SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und)/90.0 AS dpd FROM vtadia WHERE vta_fch > (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) - 90 AND vta_fch <= (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) GROUP BY vta_art) d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd WHERE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) < a.art_ptr AND a.art_cd NOT IN (SELECT o.ocp_art FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))

WITH tot AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art HAVING SUM(exi_qty) > 0)
SELECT a.alm_dsc AS cedis, COUNT(*) AS skus_excedente
FROM exidet e JOIN tot t ON t.exi_art = e.exi_art JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = e.exi_alm
WHERE e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (t.stock / 3.0)
GROUP BY a.alm_dsc ORDER BY skus_excedente DESC, a.alm_dsc ASC

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr, a.art_crt,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)::numeric/90 AS d90
  FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_cst,
  CEIL(COALESCE(d.d90,0) * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM stock s LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < s.art_ptr
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED')))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst > 100000

WITH val AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, CEIL(0.2 * COUNT(*))::int AS k FROM artmst),
top AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM val ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC LIMIT (SELECT k FROM n)
),
clase_a AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM val WHERE art_crt
  UNION
  SELECT art_cd FROM top
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clase_a
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.ocp_qty * a.art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto FROM ocpcab o JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = o.ocp_art WHERE a.art_crt = true AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED')
SELECT ocp_sts, COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab GROUP BY ocp_sts

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
d AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_ptr, a.art_crt, p.prv_dte,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.vta_und) FROM vtadia v, c
      WHERE v.vta_art = a.art_cd AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f), 0) / 90.0 AS dd
  FROM artmst a JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d
WHERE art_ptr < dd * prv_dte * CASE WHEN art_crt THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.2 END

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas30 AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(v.vta_und),0)/30.0 AS prom30
  FROM artmst a CROSS JOIN corte c
  LEFT JOIN vtadia v ON v.vta_art=a.art_cd AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY a.art_cd),
ventas90 AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(v.vta_und),0)/90.0 AS prom90
  FROM artmst a CROSS JOIN corte c
  LEFT JOIN vtadia v ON v.vta_art=a.art_cd AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY a.art_cd),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art=a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_ptr, p.prv_dte, s.total, v30.prom30, v90.prom90,
    (p.prv_dte * v90.prom90 * 1.5) AS ptr_pol
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id=a.art_prv
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd=a.art_cd
  JOIN ventas30 v30 ON v30.art_cd=a.art_cd
  JOIN ventas90 v90 ON v90.art_cd=a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total < ptr_pol OR (prom30>0 AND total/prom30 < prv_dte) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_politica,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total < art_ptr OR (prom30>0 AND total/prom30 < prv_dte) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_art_ptr

  FROM artmst a),

  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art=d.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))),
m AS (SELECT p.*, p.qty*p.art_cst AS monto FROM prop p)
SELECT CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 'comprador' WHEN monto <= 250000 THEN 'gerente' ELSE 'director' END AS nivel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH v AS (SELECT vta_art AS art, SUM(vta_und) AS s FROM vtadia WHERE vta_fch > DATE '2026-09-26' - 30 AND vta_fch <= DATE '2026-09-26' GROUP BY vta_art), st AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd) SELECT a.art_cd AS sku, st.tot, v.s, p.prv_dte FROM artmst a JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv JOIN st ON st.art_cd = a.art_cd JOIN v ON v.art = a.art_cd WHERE a.art_crt = true AND v.s > 0 AND st.tot * 30.0 / v.s < p.prv_dte ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)/30.0 AS prom
  FROM vtadia v, c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art

stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
riesgo AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte,
         COALESCE(s.total,0)/vt.prom AS cob
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd AND vt.prom > 0

)

GROUP BY prv_nm, prv_dte
ORDER BY skus_en_riesgo DESC, prv_nm ASC

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (

),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)::numeric / 90 AS d
  FROM vtadia v CROSS JOIN corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CEIL(COALESCE(d.d,0) * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) * s.art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto,
       COUNT(*) AS n_skus
FROM stock s
LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
WHERE s.stk < s.art_ptr
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))

WITH val AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst * COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
rk AS (
  SELECT art_cd, art_crt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC) AS pos,
         (SELECT CEIL(0.2 * COUNT(*)) FROM artmst) AS top_n
  FROM val
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM rk WHERE art_crt OR pos <= top_n

argumentos.sql:
with cut as (select max(vta_fch) d from vtadia),
stock as (select exi_art, sum(exi_qty) qty from exidet group by exi_art),
v30 as (select vta_art, sum(vta_und)/30.0 d30 from vtadia, cut where vta_fch > cut.d - 30 and vta_fch <= cut.d group by vta_art),
v90 as (select vta_art, sum(vta_und)/90.0 d90 from vtadia, cut where vta_fch > cut.d - 90 and vta_fch <= cut.d group by vta_art)
select count(*) as n
from artmst a
join prvmst p on p.prv_id = a.art_prv
left join stock s on s.exi_art = a.art_cd
left join v30 on v30.vta_art = a.art_cd
left join v90 on v90.vta_art = a.art_cd
where a.art_crt
and (
  coalesce(s.qty,0) < coalesce(v90.d90,0) * p.prv_dte * 1.5
  or (coalesce(v30.d30,0) > 0 and coalesce(s.qty,0) / v30.d30 < p.prv_dte)
)

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)::numeric/90 AS prom FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 89 AND c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
base AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_crt, COALESCE(d.prom,0) AS prom
  FROM artmst a JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE s.tot < a.art_ptr
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED')))
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CEIL(prom * CASE WHEN art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) * art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto FROM base

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) AS stock,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.vta_und) FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_art = a.art_cd AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f),0) AS vent90
  FROM artmst a
),
prop AS (
  SELECT b.*, CEIL(b.vent90 / 90.0 * CASE WHEN b.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.stock < b.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = b.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst BETWEEN 50000 AND 250000

ventas AS (SELECT a.art_cd, SUM(v.vta_und)/30.0 AS adu FROM artmst a JOIN vtadia v ON v.vta_art=a.art_cd, c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.corte - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.corte GROUP BY a.art_cd),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art=a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
r AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte, s.tot, v.adu FROM artmst a JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id=a.art_prv JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd=a.art_cd JOIN ventas v ON v.art_cd=a.art_cd WHERE a.art_crt = true AND v.adu > 0 AND s.tot/v.adu < p.prv_dte)
SELECT prv_nm AS proveedor, prv_dte AS dias FROM r GROUP BY prv_nm, prv_dte ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, prv_nm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.alm_cdd, COUNT(DISTINCT e.exi_art) AS skus FROM exidet e JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = e.exi_alm WHERE e.exi_art IN (SELECT exi_art FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art HAVING SUM(exi_qty) > 0) AND e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (SELECT SUM(e2.exi_qty) FROM exidet e2 WHERE e2.exi_art = e.exi_art) / 3.0 GROUP BY a.alm_cdd

argumentos.respuesta: Fecha de corte: 2026-09-26 (última venta registrada). Se encontraron 11 SKUs críticos en riesgo (cobertura en días menor al tiempo de entrega del proveedor). resultados.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS fch FROM vtadia), stk AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art=a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd), dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)/90.0 AS d90 FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.fch - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.fch GROUP BY v.vta_art), prop AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, CEIL(COALESCE(d.d90,0) * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty FROM artmst a JOIN stk s ON s.art_cd=a.art_cd LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art=a.art_cd WHERE s.tot < a.art_ptr AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art=a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))), amt AS (SELECT qty*art_cst AS monto FROM prop) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comprador FROM amt

La base solo tiene el maestro de proveedores (prvmst, con el tiempo de entrega pactado prv_dte), el de artículos, existencias (exidet), ventas diarias (vtadia) y encabezados de órdenes de compra (ocpcab, con cantidad pedida y estado de aprobación). Para calcularlo hace falta una tabla de recepciones o entregas a proveedores con esos campos. Con ella, el cálculo sería: entregas a tiempo y completas / total de entregas, por proveedor, en el trimestre anterior.

WITH t AS (
  SELECT a.art_lin,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.alm_cdd='Monterrey' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) AS mty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.alm_cdd='Guadalajara' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) AS gdl
  FROM exidet e
  JOIN almmst l ON l.alm_id = e.exi_alm
  JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = e.exi_art
  GROUP BY a.art_lin
)
